goal: Make the phone-only workflow survive DSP power-cycles: no Connect tap, no bridge restart, no stale UI state.

rootCauseOfWin32Error.symptom: every API returned 'write error: Win32Error' and all channels showed identical EQ
rootCauseOfWin32Error.cause: DSP dropped off USB (power/cable); DspClient.IsOpen stayed true on the stale handle, Open() early-returned, every write died
rootCauseOfWin32Error.evidence: Get-PnpDevice VID_1483&PID_1095 -> Present=False, Status=Unknown during incident

changes.what: _broken flag: Send() sets it on write error/short write/throw; IsOpen = _dev!=null && _dev.IsOpen && !_broken; Open() releases half-state before reopening; success clears it
changes.effect: IsOpen is now honest - a dead handle reports closed, so Connect and the watcher notice

changes.what: LinkWatcher thread: every 5 s (ManualResetEvent-woken on shutdown) under _apiLock, opens the DSP if closed/broken, then RefreshDeviceGroupMask+RefreshProductDetail; logs state changes only. /api/info gains autoReconnect=true. DoConnect: probe-read a healthy link, close+reopen only on failure (no needless USB churn).
changes.effect: bridge self-heals the USB link; turning the key is all it takes

changes.what: connectDone(d) shared by Connect button, bridgeAutoConnect poll (10 s, /api/info.open -> /api/connect), and page init (init pulls real state when link already up). Old btnConnect.click() trick removed.
changes.effect: page auto-joins within ~10 s and never shows tracked restart defaults (memory 0, -3.0 dB) as device truth; memory selector jumps to the DSP's active preset via renderStatus memChanged branch

verification: build.ps1 compiled clean; --selftest ALL TESTS PASSED
live proof: watcher auto-linked the DSP unprompted (INFO open=True while no user action), page auto-connected (DOM connected/Disconnect)
page reload after patch: 0 console errors; mem button data-mem=1 lit; master -3.0 dB, groups -6.0/0.0/-6.0/-2.8, source High-level all match /api/status exactly
served HTML contains connectDone, setInterval(bridgeAutoConnect,10000), init connect pull; click-trick absent
eqread after recovery: 31 bands, band0 fc=2625 Hz - tune intact (memory 1)

secondIncident.symptom: every speaker silent; DSP absent from USB again (Present=False)
secondIncident.cause: physical power/cable - not software (all bridge/page activity read-only; connectdone.ps1 not yet applied at the time)
secondIncident.resolution: user restored power; watcher re-linked automatically; status verified: mem=1, source=0 High-level, unmuted

liveStateAtClose.note: master/groups deliberately left at user-set values per user ('do nt matter'); tune EQ/crossovers/gains/delays unchanged from w6784b.idsp load

openItems: two USB drops in one day = intermittent amp power/ground/cable - physical inspection when parked
